hook: David Holz built the generative image tool that made AI art a mainstream habit. Before Midjourney, he spent more than a decade as co-founder and CTO of Leap Motion, developing hand-tracking hardware that never found its mass market. He founded Midjourney in 2021 as an independent research lab, kept it privately held, and grew it past 20 million users without taking outside investment. He describes the project as an attempt to expand human imagination rather than to build imaginative machines, and Disney and Universal's 2025 copyright lawsuit against the company shows how far that project now reaches into the rest of the entertainment industry.
name: David Holz

quote.text: We're trying to expand the imaginative powers of the human species.

quick_facts: Founder of Midjourney, launched in August 2021 as an independent research lab
Co-founded Leap Motion in 2008 and served as CTO until it was acquired by Ultrahaptics in 2019
Studied applied mathematics at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and left his PhD program to build Leap Motion
Contracted for NASA's Langley Research Center and conducted research at the Max Planck Institute
Named to TIME's TIME100 AI list in 2025
Named to Society for Science's Board of Trustees in 2026, having been a 2006 International Science and Engineering Fair alumnus

achievements.title: Founded Midjourney, 2021
achievements.impact: Built an independent, privately held AI image lab that grew past 20 million users and generated an estimated $300 million in revenue by 2024, per TIME.

achievements.title: Co-founded Leap Motion, 2008
achievements.impact: Developed hand-tracking sensor technology as CTO for more than a decade before the company was acquired by Ultrahaptics in 2019 and rebranded as Ultraleap.

achievements.title: Holds patents from his Leap Motion work
achievements.impact: Named inventor on US Patent 9,696,795, assigned to Leap Motion, covering methods for realistic grab interactions in virtual and augmented reality.

achievements.title: TIME100 AI, 2025
